description: PPO training win rate per generation, parsed from the raw training logs.
metric: winRate is the % of games won in each logged rollout batch against that generation's training-opponent mix (bin-averaged). Self-play generations hover near 50% by design.

gen7Training.prioritisation: fixed-pool and snapshot opponents weighted by (1 - learner win rate)^2 + 0.02
gen7Training.opponentCurvesNote: opponentCurves: learner win % per opponent during training, games-weighted bins of [episode, win%]; sampling follows the prioritised mix.

generations.label: Gen 3
generations.note: Self-play; training log was not preserved.

generations.label: Gen 4
generations.note: Adds explicit claim / caught-bluff memory. Only a log excerpt survives.

generations.label: Gen 5
generations.note: Adds the last-5-actions history; the previous browser bot (still selectable).

generations.label: Gen 6
generations.note: N-player experiment; win rate is per table (chance is 1/N). Final run only.

generations.label: Gen 7
generations.opponents: League: self-play, frozen Gen 7 snapshots, Gen 1-5, CFR, heuristic, zoo, random (prioritised fictitious self-play)
generations.note: Belief head + privileged critic; batched greenlet rollouts. The bot in this demo. winRate excludes mirror (self-play) games; episodes count learner episodes (a self-play game gives two).
